Napf.et: From Middle High German naph, from Old High German hnaph, from Proto-West Germanic *hnapp. Cognate with Dutch nap, English nappy.

s: Er arbeitet für 'n Appel und 'n Ei.
'n Appel und 'n Ei.et: Literally, “an apple and an egg”. From Low German and/or Central German; see Appel (“apple”). On farms, apples and eggs were often the most numerous produce, so they were very cheap. Cognate with Dutch een appel en een ei.
